description: This file defines an abstract base class for AMQP endpoints within the Eclipse Hono framework, providing common functionality such as link management and connection handling.

classes.name: AbstractAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: An abstract class providing common AMQP endpoint management functionalities, including link attachment/detachment handling and a verification method.

methods.name: AbstractAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint with a Vertx instance.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration properties for the endpoint.

methods.name: onLinkDetach
methods.description: Closes a link to a Proton client, optionally with an error condition.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles incoming link attachments, closing unsupported links.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Abstract method to verify if a message passes formal checks such as headers and payload.
